_doc: Where current skill-authoring guidance comes from. Read currency.md before editing. `expect` lists fixed strings our skills rely on: if a fetched page no longer contains one, the guidance changed and the matching leaf is stale. `review_by` is when a human or agent must re-read the source even if every expect still matches. Moving review_by forward means you re-read it and wrote what you found in `review_note`.
